description: CSFM concrete law (makeConcreteContinuumLaw) at strain states covering every regime. strain = [ex, ey, gammaXY] (engineering shear), stress = [sx, sy, txy], tangent = TS 3x3 finite-difference d(stress)/d(strain), row-major. tangentComparable is false at the origin seed and wherever the TS stencil can straddle a branch kink.
